name: How often should I repaint my rental property?

mainEntity.name: How often should I repaint my rental property?

acceptedAnswer.text: The frequency of repainting a rental property depends on several factors, including tenant turnover, the quality of the previous paint job, and wear and tear. High-traffic areas, like hallways and kitchens, may require more frequent touch-ups or repaints. Generally, landlords consider repainting every 3-5 years between tenants to keep the property looking fresh and appealing. If a tenant has lived in the unit for an extended period, a repaint is often necessary to address accumulated wear and refresh the space for new occupants.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repainting frequency depends on tenant turnover and wear, typically every 3-5 years, or between long-term tenants.
